item.title: How to Watch UFC Freedom 250: Topuria vs. Gaethje Live Online
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of sports and entertainment. Today, we're excited to talk about the upcoming UFC Freedom 250 event, a special mixed martial arts event celebrating the United States' 250th anniversary.
[Music transitions to a more upbeat tone]
Host: The main event features two top fighters, Ilia Topuria, the Georgian UFC Lightweight Championship titleholder, and American Justin Gaethje. The match is set to take place on the South Lawn of the White House in Washington, D.C., this Sunday, June 14th, at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT.
[Music transitions to a brief sound effect]
Host: If you're wondering how to catch the action, UFC Freedom 250 will be streaming on DirecTV and Paramount+. You can also take advantage of DirecTV's five-day free trial, which includes access to Paramount+ and over 185 channels. Alternatively, you can sign up for Walmart+ and get access to Paramount+ for just $1 for the first month.
[Music transitions back to the main theme]
Host: We also have some insight into the fighters' walkout music. Although not officially announced, Ilia Topuria usually walks out to "Canción del Mariachi" by Antonio Banderas, while Justin Gaethje prefers "Call Me Human" featuring Skip Marley and French Montana.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Don't miss UFC Freedom 250 this Sunday, and tune in to our podcast for more updates and news from the world of sports and entertainment. Thanks for listening!
